body:
Main moved. PR #1576 added the same `notes` plumbing for STEP import. This branch conflicted with main in four files:
- `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`
- `crates/app/src/script/api.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`

Resolution: the branch keeps one copy of the plumbing, from main. `parse_model_graded_within` now calls `step::parse_noted` and then adds the "turned outward" note to the same list. Both note sources stay. The MCP tool text names both. No refusal or check from main was removed.

One test change: in `a_lone_curved_face_is_left_alone`, main now treats the outer shell of a `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` as closed and refuses a lone face in it. The test now holds the lone face in a `SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL`, so it still tests an open face.

Tests run (all pass):
- `import_step_outward` (3 tests)
- `import_step_guard`, `import_step_closed_shell`, `import_step_guard_default_cap`
- ui lib test `an_inward_solid_is_turned_and_said_on_the_status_line`
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean

Ready for a re-check.
